credits.title: In a Violent Nature: Part 2
credits.overview: Johnny heads to a summer camp, where he crosses paths with a young, outcast camper who is forced to spend the night with his counselor sister and her friends at their annual end-of-season party

credits.title: Gale
credits.overview: When her village is inadvertently destroyed by an ever-earnest gentle giant, Gran, the lonesome town matriarch, will have to let her guard down if she ever hopes to befriend the hulking construct and rebuild what has been lost.

credits.title: BUS
credits.overview: Jackie, an anxious people-pleaser, attempts to tell her eager date that she's not interested, but after witnessing him getting hit by a bus, her guilt takes over and now she's stuck to take care of him.

credits.title: Mustache
credits.overview: In the late 1990s, a self-conscious 13-year-old is forced to leave private school for public school, prompting him to devise an outrageous plan to reclaim his old life and discover his identity.
